_comment: OUI (MAC address prefix) -> vendor name. Prefixes below were verified against public IEEE-derived MAC vendor lookup data at the time of writing. This is a small seed set covering a few common ICS vendors, NOT a complete OUI database. Extend it yourself from the official IEEE public registry (https://standards-oui.ieee.org/oui/oui.txt) or a MAC vendor lookup service for full coverage of your environment.
